page.notes: The drop cap "L" is joined to "Ibet" as printed ("LIbet"); the first letter is a woodcut-style initial and is marked as the likely letter. The Greek word ἐργαςτήριον is uncertain in its final letters and is marked [?]. The printed "inserere" and the cùm/hîc accents were read from a small scan and may be inexact. The marginal note is printed as "Ergaste-/rium ea-/fligandæ/nequitiæ." and is given as one note. Reading "castigandæ exultantinequitiæ" in the text: the printed line break after "exultan-" continues "ti nequitiæ" in the next line, so the word is "exultanti" and the note is not part of the text.
